custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' of the chain links. In real photography, even out-of-focus chains usually show distinct gaps between links due to depth of field bokeh. AI often smears these into a continuous zigzag line. Also, inspect the pendant's bail: does it logically wrap around the chain, or does it just emerge from it?
